verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine-facing filing rails, so asking whether it ships an official CLI is a fair question. The evidence shows no CLI. The channels it documents are credential-gated system-to-system interfaces: MeF XML transmission, IRIS A2A, and a SOAP A2A toolkit provided on email request. These are developer building blocks, not an official command-line tool, and the probes found no public developer or API surface at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
